question.prompt: A contest began at noon one day and ended \(1000\) minutes later. At what time did the contest end?

solutions.explanation:
Use midnight as a stopping point, since it is \(12\) hours after noon. With \(60\) minutes in an hour, reaching midnight uses
\[
12\times60=720\text{ minutes}.
\]
The time remaining after midnight is
\[
1000-720=280\text{ minutes}.
\]
Since \(280=4\times60+40\), the contest continues for another \(4\) hours and \(40\) minutes after midnight. It therefore ends at \(\boxed{4\!:\!40\text{ a.m.}}\) the next day, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Count through midnight
